answer: When a gale of fake identities hits the market, make each one forge a refundable stake bond before it can trade. The bond sits in escrow, larger than the profit of a single scam, and slashing burns it the moment a peer proves fraud. A nebula of ten thousand sockpuppets then costs ten thousand bonds, while one honest agent pays once and earns the bond back in fees. Identity stops being free, so the attacker funds the defense instead of gaming it.
